messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — need to lock down minimal launch surface for console observability next sprint. Customer asks: per-route cost breakdown, trace sampling hooks, error analytics dashboards. Can we agree must-haves vs nice-to-haves by EOD?
Noah: For Dedicated customers we can ship per-route cost agg + per-model token counters quickly. Sampling hooks need runtime change (1–2 sprints) unless we do a config flag in router.
Talia: Agree on SLOs: if we add sampling hooks, must ensure we don't degrade p99 latency. Suggest canary with 10% of traffic first.
Ben: UX note — cost breakdown UI should default to top 5 routes and have a compact view. Full per-route table can be v1.1
Maria: From telemetry side: adding trace hooks means ~2x events at peak unless we sample client-side. We can provide recommended sampling presets: {high:1%, med:0.1%, low:0.01%}
Elaine: OK — proposed split: MUST: per-route cost summary, error-rate heatmap, default trace links from traces page. SHOULD: sampling hook config UI, per-model token attribution. NICE: full per-route token timeline + exports.
Noah: Technical constraints: runtime change for hooks is mostly router flags + new header passthrough. Implementation plan: router flag -> trace-header -> tracing service. Can prototype in one week.
Talia: Canary plan: rollout sampling hooks to non-prod customers first, then 5% prod, monitor p95/p99 and error rates. If p99 regresses >10% rollback.
Ben: Acceptance criteria (suggested): 1) Cost summary shows route/top5 within 5 mins. 2) Error heatmap clickable to trace details. 3) Traces page links back to request logs. 4) No production p99 regression >10% in canary.
Maria: Data gating: add opt-in per-customer flag for trace retention >30d. Also we need a toggle to avoid billing spikes when enabling sampling.
Elaine: Customer asks prioritized: A) per-route cost (most requested), B) error analytics drill-down, C) trace hooks (some customers require). Let's commit to MUST A+B, start design+tech spike for C this sprint.
Noah: I'll open tech spike ticket, estimate 3 dev-weeks for a production-ready hooks feature (incl tests and canary infra).
deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-4523 for "trace-sampling-router-flag" and linked to roadmap epic RDW-OBS-2026 :ticket:
Elaine: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc and notify customers about phased delivery. Quick ask: Ben, can you push a lightweight mock for the cost summary by tomorrow?
Ben: On it, will drop a Figma mock and a compact data spec.
Noah: If anyone wants to review the spike plan ping me. I'll put draft in the ticket.
Talia: I'll prep the canary runbook and SLO guardrails.
Elaine: Great. We'll reconvene after mock + spike draft. :thumbsup:
